verdict: Paid ads remain offline; your organic lifeline also went dark this week.
narrative: Over the last 28 days, no spend ran on Meta or Google, and no paid leads were generated — the paid channel has been fully off. Your Google Business Profile had been carrying all inbound activity with 142 actions this period, including 48 calls and 94 web clicks, but that too went to zero over the last 8 days (August 23–30), cutting off the last active source of inbound traffic. Search interest is actually rising — organic clicks to your site were up nearly 19% this past week — but without paid ads or an active profile, that interest has nowhere to convert. Restarting paid campaigns and restoring your Business Profile are the immediate priorities, pending confirmation of the next scope, and the goal is to have both moving again in September.
